title: Local well-posedness of the two-dimensional Incompressible Schrödinger flow
summary: We consider the incompressible Schrödinger flow (ISF), an efficient model for simulating incompressible inviscid fluids introduced by Chern et al. \cite{C17,CKPSW16}, on a bounded, simply connected two-dimensional domain. After transforming it into the director formulation, the equation becomes the Schrödinger map (or the Landau--Lifshitz equation) transported by a velocity field generated from the director itself via Biot--Savart law.
